title: Specify credit pipeline: score to LTV to vault to health monitor
description: Write docs/architecture/P19_CREDIT_ARCHITECTURE.md: on-chain credit scoring pipeline, score-to-max-LTV mapping, ERC-6551 token-bound vault per borrower, ML health monitoring with the yield-hedging circuit breaker, and the hard no-unsecured-book rule. (1) The catalog gates score_floor (350) and concentration_cap (10% per borrower, 40% per band) map to named enforcement points. (2) The doc states the exact check that blocks an unsecured loan (draw reverts when collateral is zero or amount exceeds collateral × maxLTV). (3) Attestation, vault, and circuit-breaker data flows are specified. Ref: per specs/p19-credit-underwriting.md §Acceptance criteria.

title: Specify the 300–850 scoring model and score-to-LTV table
description: Specify the scoring model: wallet-behavior input features (age, repayment vs liquidation history, utilization, tx count, protocol diversity, rug/mixer penalties), score bands, the score-to-max-LTV table (75/65/55/45/35% for bands 750+/650+/550+/450+/350+, ineligible below 350), 72h staleness policy, and score_floor 350. (1) The mapping table is fully specified. (2) Any score maps to exactly one max LTV. (3) Monotonicity (higher score never yields lower LTV) is a stated requirement. Ref: per specs/p19-credit-underwriting.md §Acceptance criteria.

title: Specify 20 bps origination plus 20 bps accrual fee model
description: Specify the 20 bps fee on originated credit lines and 20 bps on interest accruals, routed to the SINCOR treasury at 0x09E2891432827D8835d2E9b83B25e2a5ba9612Ac, with worked examples for a scored line drawdown. (1) A reviewer can compute the treasury take for any originated line from the spec alone. (2) The worked example shows both fee legs (e.g. $10k line at 8% APR for 1y → $20 + $16 = $36). (3) Fee events carry per-line accounting. Ref: per specs/p19-credit-underwriting.md §Acceptance criteria.

title: Create P19 contract, agent, and test skeleton tree
description: Create onchain/src/p19-credit/{interfaces,scoring,vaults,CreditUnderwriter.sol}, src/sincor2/defi/p19_credit/, tests/pytest/test_p19_credit.py, and agents/p19-credit-underwriting.yaml as an empty-but-valid skeleton with a README module map. (1) The tree exists with all listed paths. (2) The YAML parses against the repo agent schema. (3) No test collector errors from the new paths. Ref: per specs/p19-credit-underwriting.md §Acceptance criteria.

title: Write CreditUnderwriter and scoring-agent starter skeletons
description: Write the CreditUnderwriter skeleton with ReentrancyGuard and SafeERC20, non-bricking try/catch on score-oracle reads, plus a Python scoring agent skeleton with error handling and a TOA hook stub. (1) Compiles under solc 0.8.24. (2) The agent imports and answers a health ping. (3) No unguarded external calls exist in the stubs. Ref: per specs/p19-credit-underwriting.md §Acceptance criteria.

title: Implement ScoreRegistry with EIP-712 attestations and 72h staleness
description: Implement the score registry: 2-of-3 multisig allowlisted attestors sign EIP-712 ScoreAttestations {borrower, score, issuedAt, nonce} with replay protection; borrows revert on missing, stale (>72h), or below-floor (<350) scores. (1) Compiles under solc 0.8.24. (2) A borrow with a stale or below-floor score reverts. (3) Forged or replayed attestations fail verification in tests. Ref: per specs/p19-credit-underwriting.md §Acceptance criteria.

title: Implement the timelocked monotonic score-to-LTV table
description: Implement the on-chain score-to-max-LTV table from the spec (75/65/55/45/35% across the five eligible bands), updatable only via 48h timelock, with monotonicity enforced on every update. (1) Table lookups match the spec mapping exactly. (2) A non-monotonic update reverts. (3) Table updates emit events with old and new values. Ref: per specs/p19-credit-underwriting.md §Acceptance criteria.

title: Implement ERC-6551 token-bound borrower vaults
description: Implement per-borrower ERC-6551 token-bound vaults: the factory calls the registry createAccount (ERC-1167 minimal-proxy pattern) bound to a non-transferable borrower credit NFT; collateral locks inside the borrower's own TBA; the underwriting agent executes allowlisted yield strategies inside the vault without custody. (1) Collateral is locked in the borrower's token-bound vault. (2) Only vault logic can move collateral. (3) Strategy execution never transfers custody to the agent. Ref: per specs/p19-credit-underwriting.md §Acceptance criteria.

title: Implement line issuance with a hard score-derived LTV cap
description: Implement line origination: draw(amount) requires amount ≤ collateralValue × maxLTV(live score), with collateral priced via Chainlink (staleness >2h reverts draws). (1) An unsecured (zero-collateral) borrow attempt reverts. (2) An over-cap draw reverts. (3) Line accounting matches emitted events to the wei. Ref: per specs/p19-credit-underwriting.md §Acceptance criteria.

title: Implement the health monitor with the 25% yield-hedging circuit breaker
description: Implement the health monitor: HF = collateral×maxLTV / debt; when HF < 1.15 the agent routes up to 25% of vault collateral into the allowlisted delta-hedge; when HF < 1.05 permissionless liquidation via Dutch auction (5% starting discount, 6h decay). (1) A simulated health drop triggers the hedging route. (2) Position health improves without liquidation in tests. (3) The liquidation path executes permissionlessly at HF < 1.05. Ref: per specs/p19-credit-underwriting.md §Acceptance criteria.

title: Enforce 10% per-borrower and 40% per-band concentration caps
description: Enforce concentration_cap on-chain: no single borrower may exceed 10% of total originated credit and no single score band may exceed 40%. (1) An origination that would breach either cap reverts. (2) Caps are tested at the exact boundary. (3) Cap values are timelock-governed. Ref: per specs/p19-credit-underwriting.md §Acceptance criteria.

title: Implement P19 roles, attester rotation, and reentrancy guards
description: Roles: score attester allowlist (2-of-3 multisig), risk parameter admin (48h timelock), pauser; handle attester key rotation, score disputes, and reentrancy attempts on drawdown. (1) Unauthorized attestation reverts. (2) A reentrancy attempt on drawdown reverts. (3) Attestor revocation freezes new originations within one block in tests. Ref: per specs/p19-credit-underwriting.md §Acceptance criteria.

title: Write P19 unit tests for the LTV table, staleness, and cap math
description: Write tests/pytest/test_p19_credit.py covering the score-to-LTV table, score staleness reverts, and line cap math. (1) The unsecured-borrow attempt test reverts as required. (2) Every score band maps to its exact max LTV. (3) All unit tests are green. Ref: per specs/p19-credit-underwriting.md §Acceptance criteria.

title: Write P19 full-lifecycle integration test
description: End-to-end in CI: agent attests a score, borrower locks collateral in the ERC-6551 vault, draws a line at the score-derived LTV, the health monitor hedges on a drop, treasury receives its cut. (1) The full lifecycle runs without manual steps. (2) LTV-cap assertions hold at each draw. (3) The treasury receives exactly 20 bps on origination and 20 bps on accruals. Ref: per specs/p19-credit-underwriting.md §Acceptance criteria.

title: Fuzz P19 debt-cap invariants across 10k runs
description: Fuzz invariants: outstanding debt never exceeds collateral × maxLTV for the borrower's live score; no line exists with zero collateral. (1) 10,000 fuzz runs with zero debt-cap violations. (2) Zero zero-collateral lines across all runs. (3) Stale-score draws are hit by the fuzzer and revert every time. Ref: per specs/p19-credit-underwriting.md §Acceptance criteria.

title: Simulate scored borrowing on a fork across 20+ shock paths
description: Simulate scored borrowing on a mainnet fork with real wallet histories feeding the scoring agent across market shocks. (1) No originated line breaches its LTV cap on 20+ shock paths. (2) The circuit breaker fires before any liquidation in every path. (3) Score staleness (72h) is exercised on-fork. Ref: per specs/p19-credit-underwriting.md §Acceptance criteria.

title: Assemble P19 audit-prep package
description: Audit package: flattened sources, full natspec, threat model (attester compromise, score oracle manipulation, ERC-6551 callback attacks), and a fairness/bias review note on the scoring model. (1) Passes the repo audit-readiness checklist with zero missing artifacts. (2) The threat model covers the three named attack classes. (3) The bias review note is filed with the package. Ref: per specs/p19-credit-underwriting.md §Acceptance criteria.

title: Remediate all P19 audit findings with regression tests
description: Fix every audit finding with a regression test proving each fix. (1) Findings log 100% closed. (2) Each fix links to its regression test. (3) No new warnings introduced. Ref: per specs/p19-credit-underwriting.md §Acceptance criteria.

(2) drawdown() completes under 300k gas on the reference fork. (3) All tests still pass after optimization. Ref: per specs/p19-credit-underwriting.md §Acceptance criteria.

description: Technical docs: scoring model features and bands, score-to-LTV table, ERC-6551 vault mechanics, circuit-breaker behavior, and the no-unsecured-book guarantee. description: Deliver agents/p19-credit-underwriting.yaml (budgets, memory, heartbeat, TOA hook) and docs/ops/P19_CREDIT_RUNBOOK.md covering attester outage and mass health-drop procedures. title: Build P19 dashboard and monitoring hooks
description: Monitoring hooks: originated credit by score band, aggregate utilization vs concentration caps, health-factor distribution, treasury fee inflow to the SINCOR dashboard. (1) Hooks emit structured metrics per STATUS_FEED_SCHEMA. (2) Hooks report unknown rather than healthy on stale data. (3) An alert fires when >5% of the book sits below HF 1.15. Ref: per specs/p19-credit-underwriting.md §Acceptance criteria.

title: Deploy P19 to Base Sepolia with seeded bands and a test attester
description: Write scripts/defi/p19/deploy_testnet.py deploying the registry, underwriter, and vault factory to Base Sepolia with seeded score bands and a test attester. Ref: per specs/p19-credit-underwriting.md §Acceptance criteria.

description: Mainnet readiness checklist: audit sign-off, attester allowlist finalized (2-of-3), score_floor 350 and concentration caps ratified, timelock active, dry-run default confirmed, treasury address 0x09E2891432827D8835d2E9b83B25e2a5ba9612Ac verified.
